edits.prompt_en: This is a cropped piece of a larger cartoon illustration. Make only the changes listed below and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same people, faces, hair, clothes, poses, background, colors, thick cartoon outlines and framing. 1) Put a large open picture book on the baby's lap, between his legs. Its two pages show only simple colored squares in green, red, yellow, white and black, like the block tower on the left. 2) The baby's free hand, the one now resting on his belly, moves down and lies flat on the open pages of the book, clearly touching them. Keep the baby's face and smile, the bib, the gold medal on his chest, his other hand holding up the big pancake, the five-color block tower, the counter, the boxes and the ground exactly as they are. Do not add any other objects, people or animals. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Output the same aspect ratio as this picture.

Make only the changes listed below and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same people, faces, hair, clothes, poses, background, colors, thick cartoon outlines and framing. 1) Repaint every medicine box in the pyramid on the counter army olive-drab green, keeping their shapes, the stacking and the plain stripes. 2) Move the big gold medal that hangs on the front of the counter: hang it by its ribbon on the top box of the pyramid instead, and fill the empty spot on the counter front with the same wooden planks. 3) The small box in the pharmacist's hands becomes a thick closed book with an olive-drab cover and one big round red wax seal in the middle of the cover. Keep the pharmacist's face, smile and white coat, the counter, the pine trees, the roof posts and the pancake at the left edge exactly as they are. Do not add any other objects, people or animals.
